public_url_env.AUTHOVA_BASE_URL: Core browser origin; App issuer/protocol URL source
public_url_env.AUTHOVA_CONSOLE_URL: Console browser origin; exact trusted Origin/CSRF validation
public_url_env.AUTHOVA_CONSOLE_CORE_URL: Console server-to-Core URL; HTTPS required in production
public_url_env.AUTHOVA_MODE: development HTTP baseline or production HTTPS with Secure cookies
public_url_env.SSL_CERT_FILE: Container PEM trust bundle for Core/Console; external overlay mounts bundle

private_mounts.default: generated .local-test/core,console,valkey,bootstrap and roles.sql; base Compose supplies mounts
private_mounts.https: external overlay mounts additional CA PEM bundle into Core and Console; set SSL_CERT_FILE

validation.production_https: not yet verified; requires external routing/certificates
